data.name: AgentRunStoppedNote
data.value: Stopped. What arrived so far stays — tell me where to pick it up.
data.comment: The agent's own note written into a conversation when the person stops the answer being composed.

data.name: AgentStatusReadingQuestion
data.comment: The status line an Agent answer shows before it has looked anything up.

data.name: AgentStatusSearchingMail
data.comment: The status line while the Agent searches the person's mail.

data.name: AgentStatusReadingThread
data.comment: The status line while the Agent reads one thread of mail.

data.name: AgentStatusReadingCalendar
data.comment: The status line while the Agent reads the person's calendar.

data.name: AgentStatusReadingTasks
data.comment: The status line while the Agent reads the person's tasks.

data.name: AgentStatusPreparingProposal
data.comment: The status line while the Agent composes something the person will be asked to approve.

data.name: AgentStatusComposingAnswer
data.comment: The status line while the Agent writes the answer itself.

data.name: AgentStatusListingMail
data.comment: The status line while the Agent lists the person's mail in the order it arrived.

data.name: AgentStatusCountingMail
data.comment: The status line while the Agent counts the person's mail, in total or grouped by sender, domain, period, or category.

data.name: AgentStatusReadingFiles
data.comment: The status line while the Agent searches or reads the files the person handed to the conversation.

data.name: DiscoveryMailDoesNotAnswer
data.value: The mail this run read does not answer the question.
data.comment: What a Discover result says in place of an answer when the mail the run read does not answer the question.

data.name: OutboxFailureRefused
data.value: The mail server refused the message.
data.comment: What an outbox entry says when the mail server refused the message for good.

data.name: OutboxFailureAttemptsExhausted
data.value: Every attempt to send the message failed.
data.comment: What an outbox entry says when every attempt to send the message failed.

data.name: OutboxFailureOutcomeUnknown
data.value: The message went out, but the mail server never answered, so nobody knows whether it arrived.
data.comment: What an outbox entry says when the message went out and the server's answer never came back.

data.name: OutboxFailureDueTimeMissed
data.value: The time the message was to leave at passed too long ago to send it without asking.
data.comment: What an outbox entry says when the time the message was to leave at passed too long ago to send it unasked.

data.name: OutboxFailureSenderUnconfigured
data.value: The account has no address configured to send from.
data.comment: What an outbox entry says when the account configures no address to send from.

data.name: OutboxFailureBoundExceeded
data.value: The message is larger than the mail server or this deployment accepts.
data.comment: What an outbox entry says when the message is larger than the mail server or the deployment accepts.

data.name: OutboxFailureServerUnreachable
data.value: The mail server could not be reached.
data.comment: What an outbox entry says when the mail server could not be reached.

data.name: OutboxFailureOther
data.value: The message could not be sent.
data.comment: What an outbox entry says about a failure it has no sentence of its own for.

data.name: ReadReceiptDisplayed
data.value: Your message was displayed to its recipient. This receipt says nothing about whether it was read or understood.
data.comment: The words a read receipt the reader chose to send carries for the person who asked for it.

data.name: AgentReportSourcesIntroduction
data.value: The messages the report rests on, in the order it first cites them.

data.name: AgentReportNoSources
data.value: This report cites no message and no file.

data.name: AgentReportSourcesIntroductionWithFiles
data.value: The messages the report rests on, in the order it first cites them, and the files attached to the question.
